texts.zh:
我们的科学家已经掌握了足够多的关于L-星门的知识和技术，现在可以移除锁住传送门的维护机制了。如果成功的话，位于[candidate_gateway_system.GetName]星系的L-星门应该能让我们立刻到达遥远的L-星团。

当维护机制解除后，星系内的其他L-星门在自纠错软件的调整之下也会在几年内逐一恢复使用，但率先使用L-星门的我们现在可以毫无阻碍的探索星团，这让我们比其他人领先一大步。
texts.en:
Our scientists are now confident that our knowledge of the L-Gates and the technology behind them is sufficient to abort their maintenance cycle. If the attempt is successful, the L-Gate in the [candidate_gateway_system.GetName] system should allow immediate access to the distant L-Cluster.

As the maintenance cycle ends, any additional L-Gates in the galaxy will likely also become operational within a matter of years as their self-correcting software readjusts. Still, this will give us a significant headstart to explore the cluster without interference.

texts.zh:
我们的科学家已经掌握了足够多的关于L-星门的知识和技术，现在可以移除锁住传送门的维护机制了。如果成功的话，位于[candidate_gateway_system.GetName]星系的L-星门应该能让我们立刻到达遥远的L-星团。

虽然星系内的其他L-星门会在几年内逐一恢复使用，但率先使用L-星门的我们显然可以比其他人领先一大步。
texts.en:
Our scientists are now confident that our knowledge of the L-Gates and the technology behind them is sufficient to abort the maintenance cycle they have been locked into. If the attempt is successful, the L-Gate in the [candidate_gateway_system.GetName] system should allow immediate access to the distant L-Cluster.

Any additional L-Gates in the galaxy will likely also become operational within a matter of years, but this should give us a significant headstart.

texts.zh:
虽然我们已经掌握了不少关于L-星门的知识和科技，但目前我们手中并没有L-星门。

如果我们要继续进行计划的话，就必须从某个星系中取得L-星门的控制权。
texts.en:
Although we have accumulated a lot of information about the L-Gates and their technology, we are not in possession of an actual gate.

Before this project can continue, we must gain ownership of a system with an L-Gate.

label.zh: 那我们就想办法控制一个L-星门好了。
label.en: Then we shall secure an L-Gate.

label.zh: 虽然听上去挺有意思，但我们不能再让这种事情分散我们的精力了。
label.en: An interesting diversion, but it ends now.
